item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.6.0
item.description: Security and signing. Tools › Redact marks text or areas, and Tools › Apply Redactions… removes whatever is under the marks for good (text, pictures, drawings, comments, links and form fields), draws black boxes, clears out hidden leftovers and saves; it can also delete the file's earlier versions. File › Security… sets a password to open the document and an owner password that limits printing, copying, editing, comments and filling in forms, with 256-bit AES encryption. Documents whose owner limits what you can do now show what isn't allowed, with a way to enter the owner password. Click a signature field to sign it with a certificate from your keychain, and see in the inspector who signed, whether the document has changed since and whether the certificate is trusted. Draw or import your handwritten signature in Tools › Signatures… and place it with the Signature tool. Settings has a new switch, off to begin with, for checking certificates online. Saving automatically is now a choice in Settings, also off to begin with: changes are kept when you choose File › Save, and closing a changed document asks first; turn on Save changes automatically for the previous behaviour, with File › Revert To for earlier versions.
